scope: All29 original AP Macro families:432 numeric variants and11 conceptual items. Economic assumptions, keys, distractors and arithmetic. First substantive self-review only; not independent review or empirical validation.

findings.variety: Eight numeric families now have varied keyed outcomes.
findings.assumptions: Average opportunity cost; frictionless mutually beneficial trade; closed loanable-funds market; fixed expected inflation and floating exchange for initial capital-flow pressure.
